name: M&G plc
summary: M&G plc, through its subsidiaries, provides investment and savings products to institutional clients and individual policyholders in the United Kingdom and internationally. The company operates through Asset Management and Life segments. The Asset Management segment offers managed investment products, such as equities, fixed income, and multi-asset, as well as real estate investment products and services to wholesale clients and institutional investors. The Life segment provides corporate pension solutions, individual life and pensions, and international solutions and advice; and Prudential guaranteed income plan.
